read_channels.notes: Distance in mm derived from echo pulse width and speed of sound.

access_model.notes: GPIO mode: trigger pulse on Trig, measure echo pulse on Echo.

steps.notes: Set Trig pin high to start trigger pulse.
Wait at least 10 microseconds (trigger pulse width).
Set Trig pin low to end trigger pulse.
Measure duration of high pulse on Echo pin (time T in microseconds).
Compute distance using formula: distance = T * C / 2, where C is speed of sound (mm/us).

outputs.notes: Raw echo pulse width in microseconds.

init_sequence.notes: No bus initialization required for GPIO mode. Ensure Trig and Echo pins are configured as output and input respectively.

read_sequence.notes: GPIO mode: trigger pulse and echo measurement as described in gpio_measurement flow.

timing_constraints.name: trigger_pulse_width
timing_constraints.notes: Trigger pulse must be at least 10 microseconds.

conversion_formulae.name: distance_formula_gpio
conversion_formulae.formula: distance = T * C / 2, where T is echo pulse width in microseconds, C is speed of sound in mm/us.

error_conditions.name: echo_timeout
error_conditions.description: No echo pulse received within expected time (e.g., >100ms).

evidence_spans.snippet: The external MCU applies a high-level pulse longer than 10 uS to Trig.
The module returns a high-level pulse proportional to distance.
Speed of sound versus temperature: c=(331.45+0.61t/C)m*s-1

requires_human: Temperature compensation: if precise distance is needed, temperature must be considered. Formula provided but no automatic compensation.
Blind zone: 2-4 cm, values in blind zone are random.
Measurement cycle: at least 200ms between measurements.
Mode selection via resistors: GPIO (default), UART (R5=10K), IIC (R4=10K).
IIC write address 0xAE, read address 0xAF, device address 0x57.
